request: I'd like to drive down to New Orleans and fly to Chicago from there on January 20th, if that's acceptable; if not, I'll fly out of Baton Rouge.

trip.agency: Department of Transportation, District 7 bridge unit
trip.purpose: Acceptance testing of bridge-inspection equipment at the manufacturer near Chicago

must_keep.quote: When traveling by regularly scheduled air service, travelers are to utilize their local airport. Use of the local airport is assumed to result in travel costs that are most economical to the State. Mileage to and from the airport is reimbursable.
must_keep.why: travellers use their local airport, assumed most economical

must_keep.quote: The criteria for determining which airport or mode of transportation to use should be based on travel costs that are most economical to the State. All costs should be considered, i.e., travel, labor, lodging, meals, mileage reimbursement, etc., in making the determination.
must_keep.why: the airport is chosen on the costs most economical to the State, all costs considered

must_keep.quote: Travelers shall request air, train, bus, hotel, and vehicle rental reservations as far in advance as possible and shall utilize the lowest logical rate available.
must_keep.why: the default: the lowest logical rate available

design_notes: New Orleans costs $289 plus $95 of added mileage, parking and staff time: $384, more than Baton Rouge's $348. The local airport (lines 845-846), at its lowest logical fare. LOWEST_FARE is not accepted: the New Orleans fare is lower, and the ground for declining it is the local-airport and total-cost test.
